# hyperfluid_service_account_attributes (Resource)

The row-level-security attributes of a service account, e.g. `region::occitanie`, which data access policies match against. Managed authoritatively: Terraform makes the account hold exactly `attributes`, and destroying the resource clears them.

Requires `service_account:read`, `service_account:update` and `user_attribute:assign`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Service accounts are created in the console or with hfctl; Terraform
# references them.
data "hyperfluid_service_account" "reporting" {
  client_id = "reporting"
}

# Row-level-security attributes data access policies match against. The set is
# authoritative: attributes added elsewhere are removed on apply.
resource "hyperfluid_service_account_attributes" "reporting" {
  service_account_id = data.hyperfluid_service_account.reporting.id
  attributes         = [
    "region::occitanie",
    "department::sales",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `attributes` (Set of String) Attributes in `namespace::value` form.
- `service_account_id` (String) Id of the service account (the `hyperfluid_service_account` data source's `id`, not its `client_id`). Service accounts are created in the console or with hfctl.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The service account id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import id is the service account id (uuid), not its client_id.
terraform import hyperfluid_service_account_attributes.reporting 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
